name: Daybreak Squadron: Blazeweaver
description:
The Captain of the Daybreak Squadron. An irrepressible optimist capable of ignoring any cloud of gloom, and a total, happy-go-lucky hot-blooded idiot.
"A '1% success rate' is nothing but numbers on a page! We'll just bridge the gap with courage, friendship, and pure willpower!"
Soul forged in fire! Scorching the darkness! The star that sets the fields ablaze — Blazeweaver Warrior!
Darkness wanes, and dawn awakens! The Daybreak Squadron arises!

skills.name: Daybreak Blade
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Daybreak Flywheel
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG to one designated target and adjacent targets.

skills.name: Daybreak Will
skills.description: Applies "Daybreak Forcefield" to this unit and all other Daybreak Squadron members. While in this state, Daybreak Squadron is immune to DMG of its own Type and continuously uses "Shadow Dance of the Daybreak Blade." It is also immune to Crowd Control debuffs, and its Toughness cannot be reduced. When Daybreak Squadron is in the "Daybreak Forcefield" state, it uses "Daybreak Dispersal" after being attacked a certain number of times. If an attack deals <u>Elation DMG</u>, that attack instead increases the tally by <unbreak>3[i]</unbreak>.

skills.name: Shadow Dance of the Daybreak Blade
skills.description: Deals massive Fire DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Daybreak Dispersal
skills.description: Dispels "Daybreak Forcefield," loses a certain amount of HP, and applies "Disheartened" to this unit, increasing DMG taken and reducing this unit's Fire RES.
